context: Ren and Asuka discuss balancing work and study.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: academic chat; vocabulary (働い/無視/かける/学会/超える) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 働きながら、学べるか不安です。
lines.en: I'm anxious about studying while working.
lines.style: troubled young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 働いて学ぶ人は、たくさんいますよ。
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured encouraging clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 学会に、参加してもいいですか?
lines.en: May I attend the conference too?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ぜひ、学会に時間をかけて下さい。
lines.en: Please devote time to the conference.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 不安を、無視できないんです。
lines.style: honest young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 不安を無視せず、向き合いましょう。
lines.en: Let's face the anxiety rather than ignore it.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 自分を、超えられる気がしてきました。
lines.en: I'm starting to feel I can surpass myself.
lines.style: motivated young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 働いた経験が、学びを超えて活きますよ。
lines.en: Work experience enriches learning beyond measure.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
